### 🧭 Type of Feature

Please select the most appropriate category:

- [x] Enhancement to existing functionality
- [x] New feature or capability

### 🧭 Epic

**Title:** A team should be allowed to have multiple owners
**Goal:** Remove single point of failure where the team creator is the only person able to work with team  resources
**Why now:** We have several admins but only a single one is allowed to create vMCPs for our main team, as they created the team. Noone else can do it

---

### 🧑🏻‍💻 User Story 1

**As a:** platform_admin or team owner
**I want:** to add other users as team owners
**So that:** owners can add or generally maintain configuration

---

I would have assumed platform_admins could create a vMCP for a team but just get this error
`Failed to update server: User membership in team not sufficient for this update.`

If I was not in the team I probably couldn't even view these resources.
Also with an API token I can create MCPs for a team but I cannot then edit them afterwards

comments.author: snorlaX-sleeps
comments.body:
Closing as you can set multiple owners but could not see that until logged in as root admin rather than just a platform-admin.
Still seems a bit odd as a team member (and maybe as a platform-admin but not a team admin) I can create a team MCP server but cannot then update or delete it
